comment: A Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) associated with a filament eruption on 8-AUG could deliver a glancing blow during the 1st interval, increasing the likelihood of ACTIVE to isolated STORM G1 periods. We expect the enhancement in solar wind speed to be short-lived, and solar wind conditions to return to background levels by the end of the third forecast period. A high speed stream from a northern coronal hole is anticipated to arrive toward the end of the week.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
